description: This file defines an 'EmptyPartitionPlugin' class used as a plugin for the 'wic' build system. The plugin creates unformatted empty disk partitions during image creation. It includes a class with a method to prepare a partition, and references the base 'SourcePlugin' class from the 'wic.pluginbase' module.

classes.name: EmptyPartitionPlugin
classes.description: A plugin class used by wic to create unformatted empty partitions within disk images.

methods.name: do_prepare_partition(cls, part, source_params, cr, cr_workdir, oe_builddir, bootimg_dir, kernel_dir, rootfs_dir, native_sysroot)
methods.description: Method called to populate the partition content; in this plugin, it performs no action and simply returns.

ctags.name: do_prepare_partition
ctags.pattern: /^    def do_prepare_partition(cls, part, source_params, cr, cr_workdir,$/
ctags.signature: (cls, part, source_params, cr, cr_workdir, oe_builddir, bootimg_dir, kernel_dir, rootfs_dir, native_sysroot)
